application.when: biome:grassland; perimeter ring 1-2 of any building (architectureClaimAt perimeter predicate); free ground (no flora/road/door_path claim); settlement_tier any; age/wealth honestly absent (trimmed vs wild leaning deferred)
application.chanceOrDensity: density ~0.18 of free perimeter tiles, tight footprint ellipse so ambient F2/F4 flora still draws between

objects.label: Round leafy shrub
objects.biomeSkins: flora-reskin to each biome's bush silhouette + palette: arctic/tundra default state=snow_dusted (frozen dress) and wilting-leaning; desert/savanna/steppe swap to sparse dryland scrub (sage/thorn) and skip wind_sway lushness; swamp/dense_forest default mossy_overgrown dress; mystic glows with bioluminescent leaf tips (faint emissive); volcanic ash-greyed foliage; lit-multiplier 1.0 (no own light). Drop in deep_ocean/ocean/shallow_water (no ground plane).
objects.notes: wind_sway applies because living foliage sways (a property of the plant, not a light/cloth) — the shader-sway codeEffect bends the canopy mass. Breakable because foliage is trampled/cut; the trampled stump persists as an object-permanence delta. No light, no content (non-bearing ornamental shrub).

objects.label: Flowering lavender shrub
objects.biomeSkins: reskins to the biome bloom catalog flower (grassland=wild_lavender; forest=wildflower_cluster; hills=mountain_bluebell; desert=desert_marigold; mystic=moonpetal glow; volcanic=fire_flower ember tips). Cold biomes (arctic/tundra/taiga) default content=spent + snow dress; swamp default=spent damp. Drop on water biomes.
objects.notes: Grassland reskin uses wild_lavender from the bloom catalog. wind_sway because living flowering foliage sways. content axis is seasonal bloom (base→flowering→spent), orthogonal to lifecycle wear — not a yield harvest, so no interact verb. No light despite mystic glow (that is a biomeSkin emissive multiplier, not a light source).

objects.label: Berry bramble bush
objects.biomeSkins: reskins berry type per biome (grassland=bramble; forest=elderberry; tundra=cloudberry; tropical_forest=guava cane). Cold biomes default content=harvested in winter + snow dress. Mystic=glowfruit (emissive berries, still no cast light). Drop on water biomes; desert/steppe rare (skip unless oasis-adjacent).
objects.notes: interact.verb=use because the bramble yields a resource on a harvest_pull stroke, emitting berry_yield into the inventory/item system. content axis=fill is the yield cycle (budding→fruiting→harvested→regrow), orthogonal to lifecycle and seasonal axes. Still breakable as a plant.

application.when: biome:grassland; perimeter ring 1 hugging the wall base, sunny (south/east exposure) faces preferred; free ground; dwelling/inn/shrine roles favour beds (wealthy/cared-for leaning honestly absent — placed by default density until a maintenance sim source exists)
application.chanceOrDensity: density ~0.12, clustered (bed runs of 2-3 adjacent perimeter tiles), tight ellipse

objects.label: Cornflower bed patch
objects.biomeSkins: reskins to biome bloom catalog: grassland=cornflower, forest=wildflower_cluster, hills=rock_rose, desert=sand_verbena, savanna=flame_lily, swamp=swamp_iris, mystic=aether_bloom (faint glow), volcanic=ash_bloom. Cold biomes (arctic/tundra/taiga) default content=snow_capped most of the year. Drop on water biomes.
objects.notes: Grassland reskin uses cornflower from the bloom catalog. Small 64px clustered patch (multiple stems) sized 1 tile. wind_sway because flower stems sway in wind. content axis=season carries the bloom/snow cycle including snow_capped for cold-biome skins. No interact (ornamental bed, not harvested). Breakable to a trampled-bare delta.

objects.label: Daisy border row
objects.biomeSkins: reskins to biome bloom catalog: grassland=daisy_cluster, forest=wood_sorrel, beach=dune_daisy, steppe=yarrow, mystic=starlight_orchid, volcanic=sulfur_rose. Cold biomes default snow_capped. Drop on water biomes.
objects.notes: Grassland reskin uses daisy_cluster from the bloom catalog. Same rationale as cornflower patch — an ornamental sway-flower bed with a seasonal content cycle, breakable, no interact, no light.

objects.label: Stone-edged planter trough
objects.biomeSkins: stone host swaps to the biome wall material family (grassland=fieldstone trough; forest=hewn log planter; beach=coral-block trough; volcanic=basalt; mystic=carved rune-stone). Cold biomes default content=snow_capped/empty in winter. The held flower child reskins via the flower-bed bloom catalog. Drop on water biomes.
objects.notes: The trough body is rigid masonry — static, no wind_sway. wind_sway belongs only to the planted flowers it HOLDS (attach.holds the flower-bed child, which carries its own sway). variants drivenBy material because the trough is a stone-host artefact. content axis=season tracks what is planted; destructible cracks like other masonry.

application.when: biome:grassland; perimeter ring 1-3, fills ground left undressed by larger props; any role; default density (an unkempt-vs-mown lean is honestly absent until a maintenance sim source exists)
application.chanceOrDensity: density ~0.30 of remaining free perimeter tiles, very tight ellipse, low priority (fills after shrubs/beds claim)

objects.label: Meadow grass clump
objects.biomeSkins: reskins to biome ground cover: grassland=lush meadow tuft, savanna/steppe=tall golden bunchgrass, desert=sparse dry tussock, tundra/arctic=sedge with snow_capped default, swamp=marsh sedge, mystic=glowgrass (faint emissive), volcanic=ash-grey tuft. Drop on water biomes.
objects.notes: Smallest living ground flora — wind_sway because blades sway. NOT destructible: at this scale, taxonomy says destruction = removal (claim freed), not a damage sprite (matches the F2 32px rule). content axis=season carries the green→golden→snow seasonal recolour. No interact, no light.

objects.label: Tall fountain grass
objects.biomeSkins: reskins per biome bunchgrass; savanna/steppe is the native default (tall seed plumes), cold biomes default snow_capped/spent, mystic adds drifting spores. Drop on water biomes.
objects.notes: Same sway/no-destructible/no-interact rules as the meadow clump; a taller ornamental variant with a seed-plume seasonal state.

application.when: biome:grassland; perimeter ring 1-3; field-cleared cobbles cluster near foundations and wall bases; any role; default density
application.chanceOrDensity: density ~0.10, may cluster in small piles, tight ellipse

objects.label: Field cobble
objects.biomeSkins: stone palette per biome: grassland=grey-tan glacial cobble, desert=sandstone, volcanic=black basalt, mystic=rune-flecked crystal stone, arctic/tundra default state=snow-capped, swamp/dense_forest default state=mossy_overgrown. Universal (rocks belong everywhere there is a ground plane). Drop only on deep_ocean/ocean/shallow_water.
objects.notes: MATTER, not Life — no spine, no lifecycle states; only the dress axis (base/mossy_overgrown) and biome snow/moss defaults. static (a rock does not sway). Not destructible (an immovable cobble has no broken_state worth a delta at this scale; it is honestly inert). No light, no content, no interact.

objects.label: Lichen boulder pair
objects.biomeSkins: as field cobble but larger: biome stone palette, mossy_overgrown default in damp biomes, snow-cap in cold biomes, faint rune-glow reskin (no cast light) in mystic, obsidian sheen in volcanic. Drop on water biomes.
objects.notes: Larger inert matter; same MATTER rules as the field cobble (static, no spine, not destructible, no affordances). 96px for a more prominent landscape accent.

application.when: biome:grassland; perimeter tiles in shade/north exposure and near downspout/drip lines and high-traffic worn ground; wetness>=0.4 (from terrain-suitability water-proximity) favours; any role
application.chanceOrDensity: density ~0.08, gated up by wetness, tight ellipse hugging wall-base shade

objects.label: Muddy puddle patch
objects.biomeSkins: wetness-driven state default per biome: swamp/river/lake/shallow_water default=wet_puddle, desert/steppe/savanna default=dried_cracked (rare), arctic/tundra/taiga default=frozen, volcanic=baked_cracked recolour. A wet-puddle skin gets a procedural specular sheen via the GL water-reflection pass (no own sprite). Drop on full-water biomes (ocean/deep_ocean).
objects.notes: A scattered GROUND SPRITE patch (mechanism C), NOT a D0–D2 painted surface — so coverage is null per the schema rule (coverage is reserved for surface fields). The dress states are wetness-driven discrete patches (damp/wet/dried/frozen). MATTER — no spine, static, not destructible, no interact, no light. The wet sheen is a GL effect, never a 2D overlay.

application.when: biome:grassland; perimeter tiles ALONGSIDE (not on) the door_path — informal flag-stone footing across lawn from path to a secondary entrance/garden; dwelling/inn roles favour; default density
application.chanceOrDensity: density: a short run of 3-5 spaced stones laid along a generated short spur, ~0.05 of buildings get a stepping-stone spur

objects.label: Flat flagstone
objects.biomeSkins: flag material per biome: grassland=grey slate flag, desert=sandstone slab, volcanic=basalt paver, beach=coral slab, mystic=glyph-etched stone (faint rune detail, no cast light). Damp biomes (swamp/river/dense_forest) default mossy_overgrown; cold biomes get a snow-dusted edge. Drop on full-water biomes.
objects.notes: MATTER paver — static, no spine. NOT placed ON the door_path (avoid) but as a deliberately laid garden footing run beside it; the placement spur is short and method=scatter spaced. Not destructible (a sunk flag has no meaningful broken delta here). mossy/cracked are dress states only. No interact (you simply walk over it — no verb).

application.when: biome:grassland; perimeter tiles, denser under/beside tree canopy and against wall bases where wind piles them; seasonal (autumn lean honestly absent until a season sim source exists — placed at low default density); any role
application.chanceOrDensity: density ~0.14 of free perimeter tiles, very tight low-priority ellipse, fills after living flora

objects.label: Scattered leaf litter
objects.biomeSkins: leaf type/colour per biome canopy: grassland/forest=amber-russet broadleaf, taiga=pine-needle litter, tropical_forest=large green-brown frond litter, savanna=dry tan scatter, mystic=glowing fallen petals (faint emissive), volcanic=ash-flecked. Cold biomes default state=snow_dusted. Drop on water biomes and treeless desert/steppe (sparse or none).
objects.notes: MATTER ground litter — static SPRITE scatter (not a coverage surface, so coverage is null). dress states are fresh→decayed seasonal/wear plus a snow_dusted cold default. Not destructible, no interact, no light. The optional drifting-leaf particle is a separate D6/weather effect, not this static pile.

application.when: biome:grassland; perimeter ring 1 on sunny (south/east) faces, near the kitchen/door side; dwelling/inn/apothecary/shrine roles favour; settlement_tier hamlet+ ; default density
application.chanceOrDensity: density: a small bordered plot occupying a cluster of 2-4 adjacent perimeter tiles, ~0.10 of dwellings

objects.label: Raised herb bed
objects.biomeSkins: border-host swaps to biome material (grassland=timber-frame board edge or fieldstone kerb; forest=hewn log edge; desert=adobe kerb; volcanic=basalt kerb; mystic=carved rune-board). Held herb rows reskin to biome herb flora. Cold biomes default content=snow_capped/tilled in winter. Drop on water biomes.
objects.notes: hybrid because the bed FRAME is a spline-assembled border (tile-along boards via spline-assembly) holding planted herb-row children. The frame is rigid static; wind_sway lives only on the held herb children. content axis=season tracks the cultivation cycle; destructible collapses to a bed-and-soil delta. attach.holds the herb rows so each herb is its own harvestable object.

objects.label: Planted herb row
objects.biomeSkins: herb species reskin per biome culinary/medicinal flora (grassland=thyme/sage/mint cluster; desert=aloe/wormwood; tundra=lichen-herb; mystic=manapetal herb with faint glow). Cold biomes default harvested in winter. Drop on water biomes.
objects.notes: A living herb plant — wind_sway (foliage sways), lifecycle spine states. interact.verb=use yields herb_yield on a harvest_pull stroke. content axis=fill is the harvest yield cycle. Breakable as a plant. Placed as the attach child of the raised bed (or free in an in-ground plot).

application.when: biome:grassland; perimeter ring 2-3 (kitchen-garden setback) on sunny faces, rear/side of dwelling; farmstead/dwelling roles favour; settlement_tier hamlet+ ; default density
application.chanceOrDensity: density: a furrow run of 3-6 adjacent perimeter tiles tiled-along the ridge direction, ~0.12 of dwellings/farmsteads

objects.label: Tilled furrow mound
objects.biomeSkins: soil tone per biome (grassland=dark loam, desert=pale sand-tilth rare, volcanic=ash-grey tilth, tundra=frozen tilth default). Held crop reskins to biome cultivar. Cold biomes default content=snow_capped. Drop on water biomes.
objects.notes: The bare earth FURROW is matter — static, tile-along repeated along the row direction, no spine. content axis=season tracks the planting cycle; the actual swaying CROP is the attach child (so wind_sway is on the crop, not the soil). Not destructible (tilled earth has no broken delta).

objects.label: Vegetable crop clump
objects.biomeSkins: cultivar reskin per biome (grassland=cabbage/turnip/bean leaf-clump; desert=gourd; tropical_forest=taro; mystic=glowroot leaves). Cold biomes default harvested/dead in winter. Drop on water biomes.
objects.notes: A living crop — wind_sway (leaves sway), lifecycle spine, tile-along to sit on each furrow mound. interact.verb=use yields vegetable_yield on harvest_pull. content axis=fill is the yield cycle. Breakable to a trampled delta. The attach child of the furrow mound.

application.when: biome:grassland; outer perimeter ring 2-3 forming a boundary line along property edge; dwelling/inn/wealthy roles favour (trimmed-vs-wild lean honestly absent until a maintenance sim source exists — default to base-trimmed sprite); default density
application.chanceOrDensity: density: a continuous run tiled-along the boundary edge with a gate gap left at the door_path crossing, ~0.10 of dwellings get a hedge boundary

objects.label: Trimmed boxwood hedge run
objects.biomeSkins: hedge species reskin per biome (grassland=boxwood/hawthorn; forest=holly; desert=thorn-scrub hedge sparse; tundra/arctic default snow_capped; mystic=thornlight hedge faint glow; volcanic=ash-grey). role-glyph variant lets wealthy/manor roles select a tighter ornamental topiary skin vs a wild farmstead hedge (honest: only the role glyph drives this, not faked maintenance). Drop on water biomes.
objects.notes: Living hedge — wind_sway (foliage sways), lifecycle spine. tile-along along the boundary line; a gate gap is left at the door_path crossing (avoid:gate_gap). variants drivenBy role-glyph so the identity field (D7) can bias topiary vs wild. Breakable to a broken-gap delta (a trampled hole). content axis=season carries flowering/berried/snow. No interact, no light.

objects.label: Topiary corner finial
objects.biomeSkins: shaped topiary form per biome species; only placed for wealthy/manor/inn role glyphs (humble dwellings get a plain hedge corner instead). Cold biomes default snow_capped. Drop on water biomes.
objects.notes: A shaped corner accent that caps a hedge run — same living-plant rules (wind_sway, spine, breakable). variants drivenBy role-glyph; the ornamental topiary is gated to higher-status role glyphs (honest — driven by building.specialization, not invented wealth). fixed (single corner anchor) rather than tile-along.

crossBiomeNotes: D5 ground landscaping is grassland-authored here as the pilot, then specialized across the other 20 biomes by three levers, never by re-authoring: (1) FLORA-RESKIN — every living object (shrubs, flower beds, grass tufts, herb/veg crops, hedges) swaps art + palette to that biome's bloom/ground-cover catalog (grassland uses cornflower/daisy_cluster/wild_lavender; forest=wildflower_cluster/wood_sorrel; hills=mountain_bluebell/rock_rose; etc. per MF_CATALOG), keeping the same states/anim/affordance shape. (2) CLIMATE-DEFAULT STATE — the per-biome default content/dress state shifts: cold biomes (arctic/tundra/taiga) default snow_capped/snow_dusted and wilting-leaning; damp biomes (swamp/dense_forest/river) default mossy_overgrown; arid biomes (desert/steppe/savanna) thin density and dryland skins; mystic adds faint emissive flora skins (still no cast light — light stays null, only a biomeSkin glow-multiplier); volcanic ash-greys foliage. (3) MATERIAL-HOST SWAP — inorganic/built objects (stone troughs, raised-bed borders, stepping flags, rock palette) follow the biome's wall-material family from building-materials.json (grassland hosts cob/fieldstone/timber_frame/wattle_daub; e.g. fieldstone trough on grassland, coral-block on beach, basalt on volcanic). DROP CONDITION: all D5 ground-plane objects are absent on full-water biomes (ocean, deep_ocean, shallow_water) which have no walkable perimeter ground; treeless arid biomes also drop fallen_leaves and thin grass tufts. Determinism: every object seeds per-tile (wx,wy) like existing ground-scatter fields (NOT per-building), mixing dressingRoot×tileHash×ruleId so the same tile always re-derives the same prop. Affordance discipline held throughout: wind_sway only on living foliage (a plant property, never on rocks/mud/flags/leaf-litter which are static matter); interact.verb=use only where a plant yields a resource (berries/herbs/vegetables) emitting into the item system; destructible only on living plants and fragile masonry (rocks/mud/flags/litter are honestly inert); light stays null across the whole field (D5 hosts no light sources — those live in D6 ground props); coverage stays null across the whole field because D5 is mechanism-C sprite scatter, not a D0–D2 painted surface.
